stemMd: Which expression has the dimensions of energy if m is mass, v speed and t time?
explanationMd: Energy has dimensions mass × length²/time². Since speed has dimensions length/time, mv² has exactly those dimensions. A dimensionless factor, such as one half in kinetic energy, does not affect dimensional matching.

distractorRationale.a: This has the dimensions of momentum.
distractorRationale.c: This has the dimensions of force.
distractorRationale.b: This is mass flow rate, not energy.
distractorRationale.e: This has the dimensions of acceleration.
